name: QiYi Bumpy Cube 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: The QiYi Bumpy Cube 3x3 (Magnetic) is a beginner's speed cube featuring magnetic positioning that keeps each layer aligned and stable, and the simplified bright color scheme makes turns easy to track for cubers just starting out.
features: Built for small hands: A beginner-friendly children's cube with a simplified layout, so new cubers get a sense of achievement instead of frustration.
Bright, readable colors: The full-bright color scheme keeps faces easy to tell apart while playing.
Magnetic stability: Magnets help each turn settle into place, so the cube rotates without the loose, wobbly feel of traditional non-magnetic kids' cubes.
Magnetic positioning: Magnets assist alignment for stable rotation and a smoother, more controlled solve.
Frosted surface: Matte finish is scratch-resistant, anti-reflective, and fingerprint-proof.
Durable build: Molded in ABS plastic to hold up to everyday play.
